candidates.rationale: The goods are described as 'bath towels,' which are made-up articles of toilet linen, and 'terry weave' of cotton, fitting the specific description 'Toilet linen and kitchen linen, of terry toweling or similar terry fabrics, of cotton' under GRI 1.

This heading covers 'Terry toweling... fabrics' (i.e., the material itself), whereas the invoice describes 'bath towels' (made-up articles), which are excluded from Chapter 58 by the nature of being finished goods rather than fabric.
